snippet.title: Studio MDHR Special Bulletin | New Game Announcements
snippet.description:
Join Cuphead himself at Studio MDHR Headquarters for a couple of exciting announcements! First up: we're delighted to confirm that work has begun on a brand new, hand-animated Cuphead video game. But that's not all! A small team here at the studio has been working in secret on something completely different: a project that pays homage to the era that made us fall in love with video games. Watch now to find out more! 

*To stay up to date with the latest at Studio MDHR*
Visit https://www.studiomdhr.com or follow along on social media:
https://www.twitter.com/studiomdhr
https://www.facebook.com/studiomdhr
https://www.instagram.com/studiomdhr

*CREDITS*

_PUPPET NEWS SEGMENT_
Co-Directors: Evan DeRushie & Philip Eddolls
Production Manager: Kyla Atlas
Storyboard Artist: Aisha Ghali
Puppet Builder: Graeme Black-Robinson
Art Director: Ben Fieschi-Rose
Set & Prop Fabricators: Kirsten Brass & Mica White
Puppeteer: Graeme Black-Robinson
Camera Operator: Sabrina Spilotro
Post VFX: Kjell Boersma & Evan DeRushie
Sound Design & Mixing: Joe Coupal
Assistants: Bea Lloret & Peter de Souza-Samanek

_MIGHTY CUPHEAD ADVENTURE TEASER_
Produced by: CONTINUE
Director: Nathan Boone
Producers: Julien Balbontin, Will Perkins, Brendan Ross
Director of Photography: Andrew Appelle
Art Director: Katie McQueston
Gaffer: Tobias Harrison

_MUSIC_
Music Composed By: Kristofer Maddigan
Engineering & Production: Julian Decorte at Canterbury Music Company, Toronto
Percussion: Kristofer Maddigan at Imagine Sound Studios, Toronto
Mastering:  Peter Letros at Wreckhouse Mastering
Special Thanks: Dan Morphy
